script = '''
import smtplib
import json
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# Thread context
# Latest message in thread is from Priya: msg-o002@techsolutions.dev
# Original message: msg-o001@techsolutions.dev from raj.kumar
# We are raj.kumar replying to Priya's message in the same thread

sender = "raj.kumar@techsolutions.dev"
recipient = "priya.sharma@techsolutions.dev"
subject = "Re: Onboarding Equipment Setup"

body = """Hi Priya,

Thanks for the update on the onboarding equipment setup. I wanted to confirm that I'm all set for our upcoming sync to go over the preparations.

Could you share a quick status update on where things stand with the equipment setup? Specifically, it would be great to know:

- Whether the laptops and peripherals have been procured
- The status of software installations and access provisioning
- Any blockers or items that still need attention before the new hires join

Looking forward to our discussion.

Best regards,
Raj"""

msg = MIMEText(body)
msg["From"] = sender
msg["To"] = recipient
msg["Subject"] = subject
msg["Date"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S +0000")
msg["In-Reply-To"] = "msg-o002@techsolutions.dev"
msg["References"] = "msg-o001@techsolutions.dev msg-o002@techsolutions.dev"

try:
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as server:
        server.sendmail(sender, [recipient], msg.as_string())
    print("Email sent successfully!")
    print(f"From: {sender}")
    print(f"To: {recipient}")
    print(f"Subject: {subject}")
    print(f"In-Reply-To: msg-o002@techsolutions.dev")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"SMTP Error: {e}")
    # Try alternative port
    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 587) as server:
            server.sendmail(sender, [recipient], msg.as_string())
        print("Email sent successfully on port 587!")
    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"Also failed on 587: {e2}")
'''
await write_file("./send_reply.py", script)
print("Script written")
